dataset_title: Top 30 Natural Landmarks, Unique Flora, and Endemic Fauna of Zimbabwe (Descending Order 30 to 1)

landmark.name: Victoria Falls (Mosi-oa-Tunya)
landmark.significance: The world's largest curtain of falling water (1,708m wide, 108m deep) on the Zambezi River, generating a mist column visible 50 km away.

flora.significance: Zimbabwe's national emblem; a climbing tuberous lily with reflexed scarlet-and-gold petals resembling dancing flames.

fauna.place_of_origin: Summit Caves of Western Chimanimani, Manicaland
fauna.significance: Zimbabwe’s rarest endemic vertebrate; a tiny (21–25 mm) direct-developing frog found only in deep quartzite caves and sinkholes.

records.citations_and_status: UNESCO World Heritage Site (#509, 1989) & Seven Natural Wonders of the World; National Emblem Act of Zimbabwe; ZSL EDGE #1 Priority Amphibian.
